newsitem.title: UK: UK to issue 650 mln stg in bond tranches.
newsitem.headline: UK to issue 650 mln stg in bond tranches.

text.p: The Bank of England said it is issuing 650 million stg in tranches of index-linked and conventional gilts of various maturities to be available for dealing from 0945 GMT.

The issue consists of 200 million stg of 7.5 percent Treasury stock due 2006, 200 million stg of 2.5 percent index-linked gilts due 2003 and 250 million stg of 2.5 percent index-linked gilts due 2016.

The 200 million stg of 7.5 percent Treasury stock due 2006 is priced at 99-05, the 200 million stg of 2.5 percent index-linked gilts due 2003 at 178-30 and the 250 million stg of 2.5 percent index-linked gilts due 2016 priced at 152-10.
